name: cache-keepalive
description: Keeps an idle Claude Code session's one-hour prompt cache warm, so coming back reads the conversation instead of paying to write it again.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Keep the prompt cache of idle sessions warm. /keepalive off stops it for one session.

maxHours.title: Longest keepalive (hours)
maxHours.description: How long after the last real turn the cache is kept, 1 to 24.

minTokens.title: Smallest prompt worth keeping (tokens)
minTokens.description: A conversation below this size is cheap to cache again, so it is left alone.

intervalMinutes.title: Minutes between reads
intervalMinutes.description: How long to wait between two reads, 30 to 55. It must land well inside the cache's hour.

hourCacheOnApiKey.title: My API key or relay writes one-hour caches
hourCacheOnApiKey.description: Claude Code writes five-minute caches on API keys and relays, which a keepalive cannot pay for. Turn this on only if you configured one-hour caches there.

pausePercent.title: Pause at five-hour usage (%)
pausePercent.description: At this share of the five-hour window, stop new work so the rest stays for keepalive reads; it carries on after the reset. 50 to 99, or 0 never to pause.

showStatus.title: Show status under the prompt
showStatus.description: Show the keepalive's state at the end of the hint line under the prompt.
